text:
sarah_support: Heads up — Glyph Labs has a Connectathon starting in ~30m in eu-central. Their demo keeps hammering realtime endpoints and the queue is backpressuring. Requesting a temporary GPU quota increase (4x A100) for ~6h to avoid customers seeing failures. Can infra enable an exception?

capacity-bot: Alert: eu-central GPU allocation 94% (sustained 15m). Admission-control active for low-priority work. Queued requests: 27. Top queued orgs: internal-test, glyph-prod-113.

devin_oncall: What exact org id and region? We can either route them to eu-west or grant a short exception. Routing adds ~80ms p90 — is that ok for the demo?

jamie_sales: @devin_oncall org: glyph-prod-113. Region must be EU (legal asks). They can tolerate up to ~200ms, but they explicitly requested eu presence and low jitter for the live run.

leo_infra: We can create an admission-control quota override for glyph-prod-113 for 4 GPUs. Plan: spin an ephemeral dedicated pool (autoscale=off) for the window. Need ok from oncall + SRE to proceed.

nora_eng: Also recommend throttling their non-critical background tasks and enabling prefix KV caching — should cut demand by ~25-35%. Good to do before we lift quota.

devin_oncall: Make the override timeboxed and monitored. Guardrails: auto-revoke after 6h, and create alert if p99 token latency > 1.5s or queue depth > 10. If that sounds good, share exact command and I'll run it.

leo_infra: Command I will run (dry-run ready):

```bash
rictl quota override --org glyph-prod-113 --region eu-central1 --gpu-type a100 --gpus 4 --until 2026-03-18T21:30:00Z --note "Connectathon demo - temporary"
```

Rollback (manual or scheduled):

```bash
rictl quota revoke --org glyph-prod-113 --region eu-central1 --note "auto-revoke post demo"
```

sarah_support: Approved by product + sales. Jamie confirmed customer agreement. Proceed.

devin_oncall: Running override now, will attach monitoring dashboards and alert hooks. Pinging #incidents if any degradation.

capacity-bot: Action: Quota override created (id qov-9882) for glyph-prod-113. eu-central GPU allocation now 99%. Monitoring enabled: p95/p99 token latency, queue depth, node GPU temp.

leo_infra: Ephemeral pool started and tagged glyph-demo-1951234567; autoscale disabled. I set protection to avoid preemption for this pool. Will tear down at 21:30 UTC or sooner if triggered alarms.

nora_eng: I pushed the concurrency cap (background tasks -> 2) and enabled prefix cache for their top model routes. We should see queue pressure drop in ~2m.

jamie_sales: :party-parrot: Thanks team — customer is live in ~5m. I'll keep sales on standby. Please note for postmortem.

devin_oncall: :thumbsup: Closing thread for now, watchers: #eng-oncall #support #sales. If anything spikes, reopen or @devin_oncall directly.
